## Checklist

- [ ] It's about one thing.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run e2e` pass on my PC. (The same checks run here.)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests: unit tests for the logic, and whole-app tests for what people do.
- [ ] Anything people can see is checked in every theme (`test-results\screens\`).
- [ ] The help pages, the README and a manual test script in `docs/manual-tests/` are updated, where needed.
- [ ] No new packages, or each one is listed below with its licence and size, and why it's needed. (They need the maintainer's approval.)
- [ ] No real documents, personal details or personal paths are added.
- [ ] Words people read are plain: short sentences, everyday words.
